purpose: Pass5 diagnostic yod contour comparison against original same-font and same-page controls; approved literal point proposals only, not whole-book approval.
canonicalApplicationState: No canonical edits by this report author; all three canonical files still match pass5 baseline at report creation. Root integrates approved proposals separately.
sourcePolicy: Original embedded source pixels only, with native crops and integer nearest-neighbor enlargements. No OCR, inferred grammar, reconstructed marks, filtering, another translation or generated points. Detached dots are preferred; a tiny bridge is accepted only when the complete low-lobe contour, position and white band discriminate it from bare yod controls. Ambiguous or saturated cases remain noted.
reviewMethod: Both primary and companion target words were verified, with tight native-scale yod frames and positive/negative typographic controls. Four compact low-left lobes remain horizontally bridged to the right stem; those were approved after two independent challenges of their complete geometry. Two other dots are entirely detached. This is a new comparison angle on previously inventoried positions, not eight newly unique positions.

companion.use: Same printed edition, independent scan; matching page headings, target rows and neighboring text checked before point use.

The primary word is saturated and supplies no competing readable contour.

decisions.finding: The target has a compact head and a thin descending, partly fragmented stem. Lower material lies in the stem/sheva region and does not discriminate a low interior dot from damaged ink. Same-page8:2 וַיִּקְרְאוּ and8:8 וּמִיּוֹם show detached lower-left dots; the same-word final yod is a bare control. Neither the primary nor companion permits a safe point or a safe assertion of absence.

The full word proves assignment to the second letter, not to the neighboring kaf whose own interior dot lies farther right. decisions.unitTextBefore: וְגַם שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר הַנְּבִיאִים תְּהִי עַצְמָתָם פּוֹרַחוֹת מִתַּחְ[תֵּהֶם׃ אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱלִימוּ אֶת יַעֲקֹב וַיוֹשַׁ[גְבוּהוּ בֶּאֱמוּנַת תִּקְוָה]׃
decisions.unitTextAfterProposed: וְגַם שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר הַנְּבִיאִים תְּהִי עַצְמָתָם פּוֹרַחוֹת מִתַּחְ[תֵּהֶם׃ אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱלִימוּ אֶת יַעֲקֹב וַיוֹשַׁ[גְבוּהוּ בֶּאֱמוּנַת תִּקְוָה]׃
decisions.finding: The target head is broadened and continuous; it has no separately discriminable low-left lobe. Same-page וַיַּצֵּב shows a detached lower-left dot and תְּהִי supplies a bare head/stem control; the nearby וַיָּרִימוּ is a connected comparison. Primary saturation and the companion head contour do not determine whether a point has merged into the head. The note is retained without asserting absence.
